name: glassdoor-review-scraper
what_it_holds: Python + Selenium/Chromedriver scraper that logs into Glassdoor and exports a target company's employee reviews (ratings, text, dates) to CSV, with date-range filtering; ~1.5s/review throughput. BSD-2-Clause, 23 commits. README explicitly notes Glassdoor's ToS prohibits scraping and accounts risk bans.
why_useful: A working, well-known method for pulling Airbnb's own Glassdoor review history (rating trend, review volume, text) as an employee-sentiment / attrition-risk proxy that correlates with headcount and culture stress — but requires login credentials and violates Glassdoor ToS, so per repo rules this is catalogued as method only and NOT to be run without a human ToS decision.
themes: Airbnb corporate footprint signals: careers/Greenhouse job-posting scrapers, LinkedIn headcount trackers, layoffs.fyi data, Glassdoor/Indeed review datasets, GitHub org activity (GH Archive)

name: JobSpy
what_it_holds: Python job-scraping library aggregating listings concurrently from LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Google, ZipRecruiter, Bayt, Naukri, Bdjobs. Returns title, company, location (country/city/state), remote status, description, employment type, salary min/max/currency, posting date, plus site-specific fields (e.g. LinkedIn job level). MIT, 4.3k stars, 842 forks, 353 commits. No documented direct company-name filter parameter, but company field is returned so results can be filtered client-side.
why_useful: One tool that could pull Airbnb's live open-roles count/mix across five+ job boards simultaneously as a hiring-pace / headcount-growth proxy (careers/Greenhouse angle) — more general and more actively maintained than a single-ATS Greenhouse scraper. Method only; not run.

name: berlin-airbnb-tableau-dashboard
what_it_holds: Tableau packaged workbook Berlin_Airbnb_Dashboard.twbx (6.68MB, contains an embedded data extract) plus a PNG dashboard image. Described as '14,274 Berlin Airbnb listings ... across 12 districts using real 2026 data'. Berlin is not in our 13-city Inside Airbnb panel.
why_useful: A committed, recent (2026) Berlin listings snapshot outside our current 13-city panel; Berlin STR data also matters for the regulation gap (#12, Berlin has active STR registration rules). name: alujjdnd/Airbnb-Mar-2022-2023
what_it_holds: 16,548,869 rows of Airbnb reviews (listing_id, id, date, reviewer_id, reviewer_name, comments) for Buenos Aires, Argentina, spanning 2011 through early 2023, 9.48GB, CSV + auto-converted Parquet, MIT licence. Despite the repo name (Mar 2022-2023) the review dates go back to 2011.
why_useful: Buenos Aires is a LatAm market not in our 13-city Inside Airbnb panel, and the review history predates our earliest Inside Airbnb dumps (Dec 2022). Reviews-based volume proxies (our 123-market stays index approach) could be extended to this market/period, and it is a genuine multi-year historical review archive of the kind gap #1 asks for (older-than-2023 data), just for a market we don't currently cover.
